description: Rename one source inside a notebook. RPC-backed (no browser). Identify the source by `source_id` (see list_sources) or by `source_name` — an ambiguous name is refused rather than guessed.

source_name.description: Part of the current source title (alternative to source_id).

name: rename_source

data.description: The tool payload on success. The exact shape depends on the tool.

error.description: Human-readable error message, present only when success is false.
